checks.name: candidate_tree_exists
checks.why: spark-fast-lio candidate source tree must exist under the ignored Results/tmp workspace.

checks.name: uses_ros2_livox_driver2_package
checks.why: ROS2 Humble Mid360 route should use livox_ros_driver2 package naming, not ROS1 livox_ros_driver.

checks.name: does_not_find_ros1_livox_driver
checks.why: CMake must not gate the ROS2 CustomMsg path on ROS1 livox_ros_driver.

checks.name: preprocess_uses_ros2_custommsg_header
checks.why: Preprocess header must include ROS2 livox_ros_driver2/msg/custom_msg.hpp.

checks.name: preprocess_drops_ros1_custommsg_header
checks.why: Preprocess header must not include ROS1 livox_ros_driver/CustomMsg.h in a ROS2 candidate.

checks.name: preprocess_signature_is_ros2_custommsg
checks.why: Preprocess process()/avia_handler() overloads must accept livox_ros_driver2::msg::CustomMsg.

checks.name: livox_macro_consistent
checks.why: The candidate currently has a typo-prone macro path; all guards should consistently use LIVOX_ROS_DRIVER_FOUND.

checks.name: livox_callback_binding_consistent
checks.why: Subscriber binding must match the declared livoxLiDARCallback symbol exactly.

checks.name: livox_callback_uses_member_imu_buffer
checks.why: Livox callback must use the class member imu_buffer_, not an undeclared imu_buffer.

checks.name: livox_callback_uses_nanoseconds
checks.why: rclcpp::Time exposes nanoseconds(); the typo nanseconds() blocks the CustomMsg path.

checks.name: pointcloud2_path_not_used_as_mid360_claim
checks.why: Mid360 evidence must go through a Livox-aware path, not only Ouster/Kimera/Velodyne PointCloud2 cases.

checks.name: mosim_startup_diagnostics_not_duplicated
checks.why: The generated startup diagnostics block must be idempotent; repeated patch runs must not duplicate it.

checks.name: mosim_runtime_diagnostics_not_duplicated
checks.why: Generated runtime diagnostics must be inserted exactly once in the Livox preprocessing path.

next_action: Build the candidate and run headless MoSim Mid360 truth evaluation.
claim_boundary: Passing this static gate is not FAST-LIO localization evidence.
Runtime evidence still requires nonzero registered cloud, odometry, path, coherent timestamps, and truth-error metrics.
